missing_information_behavior: If fish intake, current omega-3 use or bleeding/medication context is unknown, do not calculate a supplement dose.
safety_exclusions: Do not infer cardiovascular disease prevention benefit for an individual from low fish intake alone.
Do not duplicate existing EPA/DHA supplements.
Bleeding disorders, anticoagulants, antiplatelets, surgery or atrial fibrillation history require professional review.
professional_escalation_conditions: Anticoagulant or antiplatelet use, bleeding disorder or planned surgery.
History of atrial fibrillation or significant cardiovascular disease.
Pregnancy/lactation or use of high-dose omega-3.
population_and_context: Adults with low oily-fish intake; food pattern and supplement use must be considered together.
dose_constraints: No individualized dose from this rule. EPA+DHA amount and product formulation require separate evidence and safety review.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS omega-3 fact sheet summarizes intake, forms and safety; the rule must not promise disease prevention or infer deficiency. This rule remains draft; source passage extraction, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional approval are required before activation.
